label: D1 reward shown after reaching S1, early in episode
explanation: Fires only at D1 and only when the reward input is 1 (100% of mass at rewarded D1; never at GO, D2, or unrewarded/penalty D1). Only 14% of rewarded D1 steps are active, though. Two observed factors select among them. (1) The previous trial reached S1: 84% of mass; reaching S2 gives weak activation. (2) Episode time: rate is highest in the first ~10 trials and falls steadily, with nothing after trial ~75. Magnitude is largest after a rare transition into S1 (a2 then S1, rewarded): prev_common==0 covers 83% of the top quartile, and these are the trials where a model-based agent should switch to a1. Common a1 to S1 rewarded gives weaker activation. Some strong activations sit on the window first D1, where prev_state is unknown. Allowing prev_state != 2 gives F1 0.56 and mass recall 0.91, but I recorded the cleaner prev_state == 1 version (dev F1 0.59). Precision stays around 0.5 because many early rewarded-S1 D1 steps stay silent. Active steps fall in a narrow middle band of value (7.1 to 7.7). Reads as evidence that S1 pays off / favour a1, posted at reward time and fading as the episode goes on. Uses only observed variables.
